metadata.description: Australian tax and accounting plugin (single-plugin marketplace).

plugins.name: au-accounting
plugins.description: Australian tax and accounting skills for self-preparers and practitioners: primary-source rules, deterministic calculators and working papers for registered-agent review; rates for 2025-26 to 2027-28 (2027-28 partial), South Australia only for state taxes, and Australia-Indonesia only for treaty analysis (other countries get the generic foreign income tax offset).
